annotation.bound_parties_text: The act grants the state of Rhode Island and the Rhode Island Airport Corporation exclusive legal authority to regulate unpiloted aerial vehicles; it imposes no direct obligations on others.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: the state of Rhode Island and the Rhode Island Airport Corporation shall have exclusive legal authority to regulate any object capable of flying
annotation.dates_quote: SECTION 3. This act shall take effect upon passage.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: AN ACT RELATING TO AERONAUTICS -- UNPILOTED AERIAL VEHICLE REGULATION
